result.note: Mostly a corporate earnings story; only the September 2025 GST rate cut on small cars and two-wheelers is a durable policy fact worth testing.

questions.prompt: In September 2025, the Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate on small cars and two-wheelers was revised. Which of the following correctly describes the change?
questions.explain: The September 2025 GST cuts lowered the tax on small cars and two-wheelers from 28% to 18%. By April 2026 this had lifted industry-wide wholesale volumes 13.2% year-on-year in Q4 FY26, up from 2.4% in the previous quarter.
questions.source: driven by the September 2025 GST cuts that slashed tax on small cars and two-wheelers from 28% to 18%.
